variants.headline: Still in view: home world changes the charter
variants.sub: An amendment to the colony's charter has been made by the home world.
variants.body:
The home world has changed the colony's charter. Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement.

A charter amendment warrants attention, but it is not a sufficiently detailed basis for changing an operating assumption. We judge the stewardship of {target} inadequate; practical responsibility should be assessed against a demanding standard.
